findings: Source is Keller Group plc Annual Report and Accounts 2025 (Companies House no. 02442580); OCR extract covers highlights, table of contents, and portfolio case studies only — financial statements, CFO review, division reviews, notes and adjusted-performance reconciliations (pp. 66–228) are not present in this body file.

Reporting currency is sterling (£): revenue and net-debt highlights use £; CO₂ intensity is stated per £m revenue; € symbols appearing on several FY2024 comparatives are treated as OCR corruption of £.
FY2025 revenue £3,087.3m (+3% vs FY2024 £2,986.7m); no separate underlying revenue line in the extract.

FY2025 statutory operating profit £207.3m (+1% vs FY2024 £205.1m); FY2025 underlying operating profit absolute value OCR-garbled as '£2 M' but growth stated +3% vs FY2024 £212.6m; underlying operating margin FY2025 7.1% (0 bps change; FY2024 margin not legible).
FY2025 statutory profit after tax £143.1m (flat vs FY2024 £142.7m per OCR '€142.71m'); diluted underlying EPS FY2025 211.3p (+6% vs FY2024 199.9p).
Free cash flow FY2025 £175.9m (-9% vs FY2024 £192.6m); FCF definition, operating cash flow, capex and PPE disposals not in extract.

Covenant-basis net debt/(cash) FY2025 £(59.7)m (net cash) vs FY2024 net debt £29.5m; net debt/(cash) to underlying EBITDA FY2025 (0.2)x (FY2024 ratio OCR-illegible). Footnote states reconciliation to statutory numbers on adjusted performance measures section — not in this file.
Full-year dividend per share FY2025 70.4p (+42% vs FY2024 49.7p); cash dividend paid, buybacks and treasury shares not in extract.
Underlying ROCE FY2025 30.7% (+250 bps vs FY2024 28.2%).

Geography/end-market: table of contents references division reviews for North America, Europe and Middle East (EME) and Asia-Pacific (APAC); no revenue or profit split by division or end-market (infrastructure vs data-centre vs residential) in extract. Case studies only illustrate residential (Melbourne), infrastructure (New York Hudson River/Gateway Program) and power/industrial (Luleå steel mill, Sweden).
EBIT not explicitly labelled; statutory operating profit is the closest operating metric available in extract.

Balance-sheet working-capital items (retentions, WIP, receivables), provisions/claims, cash vs borrowings vs IFRS 16 leases, pension, goodwill/impairment, contract-risk/litigation language and FY outlook are not present in this truncated OCR body.
